title: You opened the app to check one thing. That was 40 minutes ago.

copy.instagram_caption:
You opened the app to check one thing. That was 40 minutes ago.

If you feel a little wired right now, that's not a character flaw. Feeds are built to hold attention, and the tight jaw and short breath are the bill.

We're building DeRot for that exact moment. It pauses your scroll, walks you through about a minute of slow breathing, and lets you get back to it, calmer.

What was the one thing you were checking? Be honest.

Coming soon to iPhone. Launch list: link in bio.
